children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Delegate operations, transfer accountability, and distinguish wipe from deletion before an irreversible action.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Transferring ownership, editing collaborators, wiping data and deleting a server need the server's owner or an admin. Servers with no recorded owner (for example created with kubectl or GitOps) can be transferred, wiped or deleted only by an admin. In v0.2.0-beta.8 and earlier, operator-role users could also run these on servers they don't own.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Ownership controls accountability and destructive authority; collaboration grants operator access to one server.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Owner can transfer and perform destructive actions.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Collaborators operate this server but cannot delete or transfer it.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Add exact usernames and remove stale access promptly.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Select an existing user who accepts the server’s data and operational obligations, then verify every downstream access path.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Confirm current and new owner in the transfer dialog.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Former owner needs explicit collaborator access to retain control.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Verify audit, backups, notifications, and on-call ownership after transfer.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Wipe keeps configuration and resets world data; Delete removes the GameServer, workload, and data volume. A wipe and a backup or restore of one server never overlap (v0.4.0).

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Collaborator = operate; owner = transfer and destructive authority

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Transfer changes accountability and must be audited

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Backup + stop writes; Wipe keeps config, Delete removes server+volume
